objective: Speak with Tenaron Stormgrip atop Aldrassil in Shadowglen.

description: <name>, is it? I heard that Tenaron has been asking for you. You'll find him in the highest room atop Aldrassil.
We may live long lives, but it's best you not keep him waiting too long.
completion: Ah, <name>. I was hoping you'd be prompt in answering my summons. I have an important task that I would like you to perform.
